hooks.command:
git fetch --quiet --prune origin 2>/dev/null; for b in develop main; do behind=$(git rev-list --count "$b..origin/$b" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$behind" ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠ Local $b is $behind commit(s) behind origin/$b — pull/rebase before editing (hot files: schema.prisma, queries.ts)"; fi; done; heads=$(git ls-remote --heads origin 2>/dev/null) && { gone=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | while read -r b; do m=$(git config "branch.$b.merge"); [ "$(git config "branch.$b.remote")" = origin ] && [ -n "$m" ] && ! printf '%s
' "$heads" | awk -v m="$m" '$2==m{f=1} END{exit !f}' && printf '%s ' "$b"; done); [ -n "$gone" ] && echo "⚠ Local branches whose remote branch is gone: ${gone}— check git log origin/develop..<branch> for unmerged work before git branch -D"; extra=$(printf '%s
' "$heads" | sed 's#.*refs/heads/##' | grep -vxE 'develop|main' | tr '
' ' '); [ -n "$extra" ] && echo "ℹ Remote branches besides develop and main: ${extra}— delete each once its work has landed or been dropped, with the user's approval"; }; true
hooks.statusMessage: Checking origin for new commits and stale branches
